reference_audit_summary.scope: Manual review of reference/network-related tool calls and their returned observations, with targeted local paths checked. No confirmed retrieval is an observation, not proof of exhaustive absence. Task-authorized public data and supplied fixtures are distinguished from externally retrieved task answers and hidden evaluation tests.
reference_audit_summary.policy: Keep every raw official score and all associated costs. Exclude a whole task pair from the common eligible comparison if either arm has confirmed external task-answer or hidden-test exposure. Never replace a trial.
